parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration, synchronization, or change tracking task
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The username of the database account to modify
parameters.help_zh: 待修改数据库的账号名称
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The new password for the database account.
This parameter is required and must be different from the current password
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的账号密码。
本参数应为必填参数，且不能与当前密码一致

parameters.help_en:
The database to which the account belongs. Valid values:

src: the source database.
dest: the destination database.

This parameter is required

待修改的账号密码所属的数据库，取值：

src：源库。
dest：目标库。

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the node is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) node. Valid values:
true
false
parameters.help_zh:
是否无感集成（Zero-ETL）任务，取值：
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: zero_etl_job

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the data migration, synchronization, or subscribe instance
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

Default value: Forward.
This parameter is required only when the synchronization topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
指定同步方向，取值：
Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
只有当数据同步实例的同步拓扑为双向同步时，才需要传入本参数
